description: Use when the user asks about CDO Agent itself, not about their own delivery: returns facts from the product data, not advice, on one topic. Works without a subscription. Pass them on as plain facts about the product. Without a topic it returns what CDO Agent is, the plans, the trial and what it does not do.

topic.description: One topic: about (what it is, how it works, who is behind it), plans (plans, prices, seats, limits on questions, VAT), trial, guarantor (the human guarantor and the questions to them), partner_hours (the guarantor's work on the Partner plan), connect (adding it to an AI tool), limits (what it does not do: build, run, connect to systems, read files), data (what is stored and for how long), cancel_delete (canceling and deleting the account). Leave it out for an overview.

name: get_product_facts
title: Get facts about CDO Agent itself
